name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official requirements are available; Fall 2027 dates and an admission model were not confirmed. Department and central pages conflict on GRE.

applicationFee.note: Central international doctoral fee. The no-fee Biology language is explicitly for master’s applications.

english.note: PTE58 also accepted. Case-by-case testing exemption with appropriate documentation of an accredited US degree; no general English-medium overseas-degree exemption established.

documents: All postsecondary transcripts; unofficial copies accepted for review
requirements.note: Biology-specific PhD page calls GRE optional; central international PhD page calls GRE required and says individual requirements vary. The Biology-specific optional rule is used because the central page directs applicants to individual program requirements; confirm directly. Prerequisites: two years chemistry, two biology including biochemistry/microbiology, one physics and one calculus; deficiencies completed in first year. Direct PhD and MS/PhD routes available; direct route full-time until written comprehensive exam, intended for applicants with undergraduate research experience.

funding.note: Competitive doctoral scholarships can cover full tuition; teaching assistantships provide tuition remission and a stipend. Noncitizens are eligible for university/department/private funding, but the department says these funds are extremely limited. Incoming faculty-grant support is unusual. No universal award guarantee.
